DIRECT ENTRY

(i)      UNN

(b)  NCE merit in Home Economics, ND lower credit in Fashion and Clothing Management Education or Home Economics or Home and Rural Economics or Hotel and Catering.

(c)     Candidates with a University Degree in any discipline in addition to the departmental UTME requirements may be considered for direct entry admission for a three (3)-year programme.

(ii)    BENIN

a.     requires two (2) or three (3) merit in NCE including Home Economics plus three (3) or two (2) 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Biology/Agricultural Science with 'O' Level pass in Chemistry.

(iii) LAGOS accepts  NCE or ND in Home Economics , Catering and Hotel Management, Textile Management and any other relevant Subject with minimum of merit pass. Very good passes in three Jupeb Subjects: Chemistry , Biology and one other subject from Home Economics, Physics, Food  & Nutrition, Home Management and clothing & Textile. Three â€˜Aâ€™ Level passes in any two relevant Science subjects of Chemistry and any one of Biology, Botany and Agricultural Science, Physics. ND with Distinction in Hotel Management, Tourism, Catering and Hotel Management or any other related course.

(iv)   EDZAR - requires three (3)'A' Level passes/NCE in Home Economics. NCE credit in Home Economics including Education.

(v)    TASUED accepts

a.           NCE in Home Economics with a minimum of Merit Pass.

b.          At least two (2) â€˜Aâ€™ Level passes in two (2) of Chemistry, Biology and Agricultural Science.

c.           Minimum of OND/HND with minimum of upper credit in Home Economics or Food Science or Hotel and Catering Management and any other related course.

(vi)      ABU accepts 'A' Level passes/IJMB in two (2) of Chemistry and any of Biology, Botany or Agricultural Science.

 

(vii)     EDOMOK accepts NCE merit/HND/ND lower credit in Fashion and Clothing Management Education or Home Economics or Hotel and Catering or Home and Rural Economics plus the UNN UTME requirements.

(i)        FC-PANKSHIN accepts 'O' Level pass in Chemistry, does not accept application of ND/HND candidates without teaching qualifications.

(ii)      YABA-DEG accepts NCE merit in Home Economics  A Level passes in two (2) of Chemistry or any Biology, Botany and Agricultural Science. ND/HND credit in Home Economics or Food Science or Hotel and Catering Management or any other related programme.

(ix)      EBSU accepts NCE merit or ND/HND upper credit respectively in the relevant programme.

(iii)            DELSU requires NCE in Home Economics with minimum of merit pass OND Home Economics or Food Science in upper credit or any other related courses.

(iv)                YABA-DEG requires Five (5) O Level NTC/NBC credit passes or TC II in English Language, Mathematics and any other three (3) subjects from: Home Economics/Management, Biology/Agricultural Science, Chemistry, Physics, Food & Nutrition, Economics, Cosmetology, Clothing & Textile/Garment Marking, Catering Craft, Health Education/Health Science, Dying & Bleaching, Leather Work/Leather Good, Tourism, Jewellery and Basketery. 

(xi)       MAUTY accepts  NCE merit in Home Economics.  A Level passes in two (2) of Chemistry or any Biology, Botany and Agricultural Science.  ND/HND credit in Home Economics or Food Science or Hotel and Catering Management or any other related programme.

(xii)     BSU requires;

a)             Preliminary degree candidates (from Benue State University only) must pass at least five (5) out of the six (6) subjects studied with pass level of at least 50% in each subjects.

b)             NCE use of English is acceptable in lieu of â€˜Oâ€™ Level in English Language.

c)             â€˜Aâ€™ Level pass in any of the acceptable subjects.

d)             A minimum of upper credit level at ND/HND or Diploma in Fashion and Clothing Management Education or Home Economics plus a minimum of credit level pass in any two (2) of the followings Home Management, Clothing and textiles, Food and Nutrition, Biology, Chemistry, Agricultural Sciences and economics WASSCE/SSCE/GCE â€˜Oâ€™ Level NTC/NBC.

e)             A minimum of merit level pass in NCE (Home Economic Education) with credit level pass in any four (4) of the following: Home Management, Clothing and Textiles, Food and Nutrition, Biology, Chemistry, Agricultural Science and Economics at WASSCE/SSCE/GCE â€˜Oâ€™ Level /NABTEB.

f)              Any other qualification that may be considered appropriate by Benue State University, Makurdi.

(i)      BENIN requires 'O' Level pass in Chemistry and 'O' Level credit pass in Biology/Agricultural Science.

(ii)     ADEYEMIDEG requires 'O' Level credit passes in Chemistry, Mathematics, and any two (2) of the following:

          Food and Nutrition, Home Economics/Home Management, Clothing and Textile, Agricultural Science/Biology.

(iii)    EDALV requires 'O' Level credit passes in Biology and Chemistry.

(iv)    IAUED requires one (1) Science subject.

(v)     DELSU requires five (5) credits passes at SSC or its equivalent including English Language, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry and Home Economics or Food Nutrition.

(vi)    UYO requires 'O' Level credit pass in Chemistry.

(vii)   LAGOS requires  Five O/Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Chemistry Biology/Agricultural Science and any one of Economics, Home Economics, Physics, Food & Nutrition/Home Management, Clothing and Textile, Garment Making/Dyeing & Bleaching/Catering Craft Practice.

(viii)  EBSU requires five (5) 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, and any three(3) of Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Food and Nutrition, Clothing and textile, Home Management.
